name: fix68_arrow_blocker
verifies: fix-68 #4: an orc archer shoots the hero with another orc in the line of fire: the arrows stick in that orc (the first body on the path), not in the hero; misses stick in the level
steps: spawn Orc_Scout_02 attitude=neutral dist=14 side=front as=archer
spawn Orc_Warrior_01 attitude=neutral dist=5 side=front as=wall
log arrows in the level: see the arrowlevel probe
notes: The wall orc is frozen 5 m in front of the hero, the archer 14 m on the same line; NPC shots are aimed at the hero at release and fly straight (fix-93), so they cross the wall orc. Its damage follows G3's friendly-fire gates (a non-target Friendly/Neutral victim of an NPC projectile takes none). If the archer walks around the wall, arrowhits:hero can grow legitimately: check the log positions.
